additional_info.subject: RE: ID0470355-DC/Si-D/MC-[Y2 / R9 313202799122] Modem issue CRM:03056000883
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Schoepff,
Thank you for your prompt reply. I believe what you are experiencing might be related also to the operator your SIM cards are connected to.
The SIM card in Siemens routers are connected at EU level to Vodafone, which grants a good quality signal and stable connection. It might be that in your location, the SIM card connected to the client's router has a poor signal strength.
If you are experiencing other issues with issues on the network connection of the SIM card, I would suggest to use a SIM card from a different operator and compare the performances.
Please let me know if further support is required for this ticket, otherwise I will proceed to close ticket
ID0470355.
Looking forward to hearing feedback form you!
With kind regards,
